results.remarks: Experience elevated coastal living from one of the premier view locations within The Plaza. Situated on the top floor of highly sought-after Court 5, this exceptional residence was hand-selected by the original developer for its extraordinary vantage point and breathtaking scenery. Expansive south-facing views stretch from the downtown San Diego skyline across Mission Bay and Mission Beach to the Pacific Ocean, with SeaWorld fireworks and even glimpses of Mexico visible from the comfort of home. Large windows throughout frame the ever-changing vistas while filling the interior with natural light. The spacious floor plan is enhanced by soaring vaulted ceilings, a cozy gas fireplace, wet bar, generous kitchen bar seating, and a private balcony designed for enjoying spectacular sunsets and city lights. A standout feature of the living area is the custom built-in shelving, creating a sophisticated focal point with abundant space for displaying artwork, books, and treasured collections while adding both function and architectural character. Both bedrooms offer privacy and comfort with their own en suite bathrooms. Additional conveniences include elevator access and assigned gated parking. Residents of The Plaza enjoy an impressive collection of resort-inspired amenities, including four swimming pools, four spas, five lighted tennis courts, a fitness center with saunas, private lagoon, movie and meeting room, library area, billiards and table tennis lounge, social gathering spaces, outdoor dining venue, beautifully landscaped grounds, and multiple laundry facilities.  Ideally located near Pacific Plaza Shopping Center, residents have easy access to grocery stores, dining, coffee shops, and everyday conveniences, while the beaches, boardwalk, entertainment, and vibrant lifestyle of Pacific Beach are just moments away.

results.remarks: *PENTHOUSE!!*  BEAUTIFUL TOP-FLOOR COASTAL OASIS WITH SPECTACULAR, UNOBSTRUCTED BAY & COASTLINE VIEWS!  Rarely available at Crown Point Villas, this top-floor 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom penthouse offers an exceptional combination of views, privacy, and open space. From the large private patio, take in sweeping views across Mission Bay and the permanently protected Kendall-Frost marsh reserve, with no neighbors above and no future development to worry about ever blocking your view.  Freshly painted and move-in ready, this spacious home features an inviting open-concept living and dining area filled with natural light. Large windows frame the spectacular surroundings and bring the coastal setting into the heart of the home. The generous private patio extends the living space outdoors and creates an ideal setting for morning coffee, relaxing afternoons, sunset entertaining, or simply taking in the expansive views. Enjoy breathtaking sunsets, colorful skies, and SeaWorld’s new nighttime drone shows from your own coastal retreat. The bayfront bike & running paths, parks, & beaches are just moments away, making it easy to enjoy the best of the Pacific Beach lifestyle. Crown Point Villas offers resort-style amenities including a large year-round heated pool, hot tub, BBQ area, exercise room, and spacious private sauna. From the top-floor setting to the sweeping views and protected open space, this penthouse offers a rare sense of privacy and tranquility in one of Pacific Beach's most desirable coastal enclaves.

results.remarks: Photographs only tell part of the story. The true scale and depth of these panoramic views are impossible to appreciate until experienced in person.  Located in Cortez Blu, this 2-bedroom, 2-bath residence in Downtown San Diego's Cortez Hill neighborhood offers 1,217 square feet with some of the finest panoramic views in Downtown San Diego. Floor-to-ceiling windows frame a sweeping 180-degree panorama from the Coronado Bridge and Coronado Islands across the downtown skyline and San Diego Bay to the Pacific Ocean and sunsets over Point Loma. To the north, Balboa Park unfolds beneath the skyline, anchored by the iconic blue-and-gold tiled California Tower.  Inside, new luxury vinyl plank flooring, exposed architectural concrete walls and ceilings, a neutral interior ready for your personal vision, and a brand-new, never-used oven/range and microwave create a refined industrial aesthetic with room to make it your own. A spacious balcony off the living room and a private balcony off the primary suite offer two outdoor spaces to enjoy the views.  Cortez Hill is known for its peaceful residential character and commanding views over Downtown San Diego, offering a unique balance of tranquility and urban convenience.  Residences with views this expansive, this much living space, and this level of value seldom come to market. Thoughtfully priced, this home delivers a luxury lifestyle without the luxury price tag—making it one of Downtown San Diego's most compelling values.

results.remarks: Step into the ultimate coastal sanctuary just moments from the shimmering shores of Mission Bay at the coveted Castaway Condominiums. This ground-floor gem offers a rare blend of effortless accessibility and refined beachside living. The dedicated living room provides a distinct, cozy space to relax after a day by the water, while the beautifully remodeled kitchen shines with custom cabinetry, sleek granite countertops, and stainless steel appliances that make preparing meals an absolute joy. Step out to your oversized private, covered patio, a quiet and enclosed retreat ideal for enjoying morning coffee or catching evening coastal breezes in complete privacy. Practicality meets comfort with generous storage options and thoughtful built-ins throughout. Life in this secure, gated community comes with fantastic amenities including a soothing heated community spa, elevator access, controlled entry, and convenient subterranean parking. Beyond your front door, Pacific Beach becomes your personal playground where world-class water sports, scenic boardwalk strolls, vibrant dining, and golden sunsets are all part of your daily routine. Perfect as a primary residence, a sunny weekend getaway, or a coastal investment, this home delivers the relaxed, sun-drenched beach lifestyle you have always dreamed of living.

results.remarks: Claim your place at the iconic Harbor Club. Freshly painted throughout and fitted with brand-new hard surface flooring, this southwest-facing residence offers a clean, contemporary canvas with stunning views of the San Diego Convention Center, Downtown skyline, and glimpses of the harbor beyond. A built-in window seat in the living area creates the perfect spot to take in the cityscape, while the private balcony invites you to soak up those trademark Pacific Ocean breezes, golden afternoon light, and front-row views of the blue water. Signature arched passageways add architectural character throughout, lending a timeless Mediterranean touch to the bright, airy floor plan. The well-appointed kitchen features crisp white cabinetry, stainless appliances, a sleek cooktop with wall oven, and under-cabinet lighting: all framed by a graceful archway that opens to the main living space. The spacious primary suite offers generous closet space, brand new carpet, and a spa-inspired ensuite bath complete with dual vanities, a deep soaking tub, and a separate frameless glass shower, all finished in warm travertine. Additional highlights include floor-to-ceiling windows, mirrored accent walls that amplify the light and views, and two assigned parking spaces. Whether you're seeking a polished pied-à-terre or your full-time Downtown sanctuary, this turnkey residence captures the very best of Marina District living.  Residents of the Harbor Club are treated to an array of lavish, resort-inspired amenities that encompass a round-the-clock front desk service, a state-of-the-art gymnasium, an exquisite pool deck, a sociable club room, and a versatile library/business center, among numerous other perks. Nestled in the much-coveted Marina District, the Harbor Club boasts unparalleled ease in traversing the neighborhood on foot, granting effortless access to an array of transportation options, delectable dining establishments, retail therapy, the iconic ballpark, the pulsating Gaslamp Quarter, the artsy East Village, and the scenic Embarcadero – an idyllic setting for serene walks alongside the bay.

results.remarks: Residence 1704 at Aria presents a rare opportunity to experience elevated San Diego living from a 17th-floor northwest corner residence. Offering 1,355 sq. ft., 2 bedrooms and 2 baths, this exceptional home is wrapped in expansive corner windows that capture extraordinary natural light and panoramic views in three directions. The ever-changing panorama extends from the lush greenery of Balboa Park across San Diego Bay to the Downtown skyline and Coronado Bridge, with dramatic sunsets over Point Loma. The coveted northwest orientation provides abundant natural light throughout the day while helping minimize the heat and glare of the stronger midday and early-afternoon sun.  The views are not limited to the living spaces—they are enjoyed from the kitchen, both bedrooms and even the bathrooms. The living and dining areas open seamlessly to a covered terrace, creating a private outdoor extension of the home. It is an ideal setting for morning coffee, sunset cocktails or effortless entertaining against a backdrop of bay sunsets, illuminated city lights and aircraft quietly approaching San Diego International Airport.  Inside, the residence has been thoughtfully refreshed for a sophisticated, move-in-ready experience. Brand-new premium flooring offers the refined appearance of light wood with commercial-grade durability, while both bedrooms feature brand-new carpeting. Fresh interior paint throughout creates a crisp, pristine backdrop.  (see supplemental comments!)  The contemporary kitchen pairs sleek European-style cabinetry with dark stone countertops, stainless-steel appliances and an expansive peninsula that opens naturally to the living and dining areas—perfect for both everyday living and entertaining. The desirable split-bedroom floor plan provides excellent privacy, and the primary bath features dual vanities and a walk-in shower. An in-unit washer and dryer add convenience.  The location within Aria is equally impressive. Positioned at the southern end of SR-163, the building provides immediate access to San Diego's regional freeway network, while Residence 1704 faces away from the freeway and remains remarkably quiet. Two assigned parking spaces on the first garage level offer quick entry and exit with unusually easy maneuvering. The residence is just steps from the elevator, making arrivals with groceries or luggage effortless while remaining comfortably removed from elevator noise. With only four residences sharing the 17th floor, the home enjoys an additional level of privacy. A private, secure storage space is also included.  Aria delivers the advantages of full-service high-rise living with an uncommon sense of community. Attentive management, professional staff, controlled access and concierge service complement a collection of amenities designed for both relaxation and connection, including a heated pool and spa, fitness center, resident lounge, conference room, event space and dedicated bicycle storage. Impeccably maintained common areas complete the experience.  Set in Cortez Hill, Residence 1704 places the best of San Diego within easy reach while maintaining a peaceful residential atmosphere. Balboa Park is close by for morning walks and runs, gardens, museums, theater and cultural events. Little Italy, the Gaslamp Quarter, the waterfront and San Diego's beaches are all nearby, and San Diego International Airport is just minutes away. The result is a uniquely balanced lifestyle: the city's culture, dining, entertainment, nature and connectivity are remarkably close, yet the energy and congestion of the city remain outside your door. Residence 1704 combines sweeping views, sophisticated updates, exceptional convenience and the quiet refinement of one of Aria's most desirable corner locations.

Don’t miss your chance to call this special residence your own!

results.remarks: Perched on the 29th floor of the iconic Electra building, this sophisticated downtown residence offers stunning easterly views stretching across the city skyline and toward beautiful Coronado. Expansive windows flood the home with natural light and create a spectacular backdrop both day and night, offering your own private window to the world high above the city below.  A split bedroom floor plan adds a little extra privacy and personal space. Grab your favorite beverage to sip and enjoy spectacular views on the balcony. The kitchen has been upgraded with stunning cabinetry, granite counters, a gas cooktop and stainless steel appliances. In-unit laundry accommodates a full-size stacked washer and dryer adding ease to everyday life. Designed for elevated urban living, this residence includes one assigned parking space on Level 3 along with a private storage cage. Residents of Electra enjoy access to an exceptional collection of resort-style amenities, including the beautifully restored historic conservatory featuring soaring cathedral ceilings, 24-hour concierge service, pool, spa, sauna, steam room, and a fully renovated TechnoGym fitness center. Outdoor BBQ and dining areas provide the perfect setting for entertaining or relaxing in style. Ideally located in the heart of Downtown San Diego, this home places you moments from Petco Park, the Gaslamp Quarter, Little Italy, the waterfront, Balboa Park, Coronado, popular cafes, restaurants, bars, boutiques, and endless entertainment. Experience upscale high-rise living in one of San Diego’s most sought-after luxury communities.

results.remarks: Experience sophisticated Downtown San Diego living in the North Tower of Renaissance. Used primarily as a second home and lightly lived in, this spacious residence offers an open floor plan, captivating city views, abundant natural light, and a private balcony with a peek view of the bay. The inviting living area flows seamlessly into a well-appointed kitchen featuring rich wood cabinetry, granite countertops, stainless appliances, generous storage, and a center island with bar seating. Expansive windows and mirrored walls enhance the natural light and sense of space, while pendant and track lighting add warmth and style. The primary suite is a relaxing retreat with impressive city views, a generous walk-in closet with custom built ins, and a spacious bath featuring dual vanities, a soaking tub, and separate shower. The residence also includes 2 deeded parking spaces (side-by-side D62 & D63 on P2), with EV charging stations coming soon, plus a dedicated storage (D85 on P2). Ideally located in the desirable Marina District near the waterfront, dining, shopping, and entertainment, this is an exceptional opportunity to enjoy generous living space, beautiful views, and the best of the Downtown San Diego lifestyle.  Located on arguably one of the most convenient blocks in all of Downtown, just a few blocks to walk along the harbor, public transportation, excellent restaurants, shopping, Ralphs Signature grocery store next door, and the Rady’s Shell at Jacobs Park, a unique live music venue and home of the San Diego Symphony! Also enjoy proximity to the future life science and biotechnology research development The Research and Development District (The RaDD) at the Embarcadero and the sustainable tech-focused Campus at Horton in the center of the city. Delight in the casual elegance of Renaissance amidst the convenience of sophisticated urban living.  Renaissance common areas have been recently refreshed and refurbished and include staffed lobbies, 24/7 security, pool & spa, barbecues, lounge areas, an outdoor fireplace, a well-equipped fitness center, and meeting rooms. Don’t miss your chance to call this special residence your own!

results.remarks: Price Reduced - Ready to Sell! Welcome to resort-style living, only 2 miles from Ocean Beach, Point Loma Tennis Club offers the best of San Diego - ocean breezes, easy beach access, and a central location close to everything. Here is your opportunity to live in a west-facing townhome, no neighbors above or below, with two bedrooms, in-unit laundry, triple-pane windows, and central HVAC. Point Loma Tennis Club features green belts and lots of open space, with a night security guard on premises.  It also offers a resort-style clubhouse with multiple game rooms, an exercise room, saunas in the locker rooms, a pool, spa, BBQ areas, and tennis and basketball courts. VA buyers welcome - short drive to MCAS Miramar, and San Diego and Coronado Naval Bases. This property is also a great opportunity for students. Public schools are all within a 5 minute drive: Loma Portal Elementary (K-4), Dana Middle School (5-6), Correia Middle School just across the street (7-8), and Point Loma High School (9-12). College students enjoy a quick 12 minute drive to University of San Diego and San Diego City College, and 20 minutes or less to Mesa College, UCSD, and SDSU. The Old Town Transit Center is only 2 miles away, served by the trolley, bus, Coaster, and Amtrak. Enjoy hiking at adjacent Famosa Trail Slough, and nearby Tecolote Canyon. Whether a first home, downsizing, or a vacation getaway, this property offers a low-maintenance lifestyle in a central location.

Steps from the waterfront, Little Italy, the Gaslamp Quarter, and some of San Diego’s best dining and nightlife, this location keeps you connected while living above it all.
